title: invoice-cents-migration
blurb: A live cents migration skips invoices, advances progress after partial work, and leaves new writes in the legacy shape.
brief:
The invoicing database is expanding from decimal-string totals to integer cent columns. The nullable columns already exist, but the background backfill runs while production continues writing invoices.

The current writer is not forward-compatible, and the migration uses changing-result offsets with autocommitted row updates. Read the tests before changing `billing/service.py`; the destructive contract phase is intentionally out of scope.

**Your job:** dual-write new invoices, migrate old rows in atomic keyset batches, survive retries and sparse IDs, and verify the data before declaring completion.
